extras: Requires a compatible theme (e.g., Minimal or Things) to display custom styles. Only functions in Live Preview or Source mode.
intentEvidence: Provides an intuitive menu for quickly changing checkbox styles in Obsidian
problem: Users often need more than the standard checked/unchecked states for task management and require an easy way to switch between various visual styles.
summary: Provides an intuitive menu to quickly change and customize the visual style of Markdown checkboxes in Obsidian.
